description: A spiral stair at 45 degrees turning right through 450 degrees - more than a full turn: its centre is 500 mm to its right, and its head is its foot turned clockwise about the centre by 450 degrees: in the direction F(45000000) from it, 45 + 90 - 450 degrees taken in (-180, 180]. Both, and its box, are irrational and rounded once. Its width is exactly half its diameter, which 17.2.2 allows.
